=== Usage ===
 {{t|Mod}} or {{t|mod|''location''}}
where ''location'' is an optional parameter for use in sections or subsections (e.g. <code>{{<nowiki/>mod|section}}</code>).

Pages are automatically added to [[:Category:Mods]]; this behavior can be disabled by adding a "cat=nocat" parameter:

 {{<nowiki/>Mod|cat=nocat}}
